items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Ordered location trail in a nav landmark. Links use react-router Link; the last item is the current page (aria-current=page, not a link); separators are aria-hidden.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included. Use inside a react-router data or declarative router. Labels clip at 24ch with an ellipsis (v3; they wrapped before), so keep long names short and show the full name elsewhere on the page.
